alex (Docs): Pushing a draft release note + migration guide PR for the docs site. Need quick eyes on the Python snippet and the redirect note before I merge.
mira (SDK): I'll look now. Which snippet changed? The generator API or the client call shape?
alex (Docs): generator API in python now yields ResponseChunk instead of dicts. Wanted to include the minimal example.
mira (SDK): ok here's a compact example you can paste:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='rwd-3b', input='Summarize changes'):
    print(chunk.text)
```
mira (SDK): add a note: "Requires python-sdk >= 0.9.0" and mention the old `.stream_raw()` is deprecated.
paul (Eng): also call out the reranker model name change. Old name `rwd-ranker-v1` is aliased but will be removed next month. Migration tip: use `rwd-ranker-v2` and rerun evals. (ENG-2201)
alex (Docs): adding: "Reranker aliasing may return 404 after 2026-05-01; update to rwd-ranker-v2 and reindex. (ENG-2201)" Toni - anything from support?
toni (Support): yes, a wave of customers hit the snippet deprecation warning. Please bold the migration line and include the short troubleshooting steps: 1) check sdk version 2) re-install 3) clear pip cache.
alex (Docs): will add bullets under Migration. Also need to mention a recent redirect issue: some legacy anchor links to /docs/guide#auth were 301ing to staging for external users. Is that fixed?
paul (Eng): that was the CDN rule mismatch we corrected last night. Permanent redirect in place; public anchor links should be stable. Still chasing a flaky edge cache, ticket ENG-2233.
alex (Docs): adding known issue: "Intermittent anchor redirect to staging for legacy pages; workaround: use the top-level page path or re-publish the page. (ENG-2233)"
mira (SDK): one more tiny ask — the JS examples in the whatsnew banner show `client.streamResponses()` which we replaced. Should be `client.responses.stream()` like our docs earlier.
alex (Docs): fixed the banner copy to show `client.responses.stream()` and added a short sentence about version gating.
deploy-bot: PR 4876 opened by alex: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4876|view PR> :spiral_note_pad:
toni (Support): thanks, I'll link the PR in our KB update and leave a snippet in the canned reply for the support queue.
alex (Docs): perfect — aiming to merge after a 30-min review window. Ping if you spot anything else. :thumbsup:
